lead.headline: Lula wins a record fourth term as Brazil's president, beating Flávio Bolsonaro by about 4.4 million votes
lead.short: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won Sunday's run-off with 51.8% of the vote against 48.2% for the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a margin of about 4.4 million votes, giving him an unprecedented fourth term. Bolsonaro refused to accept the result and said he would seek to annul it. Narendra Modi congratulated his "dear friend" on Monday.

why.text: Brazil is India's partner in the BRICS and the Global South, and Lula is one of the few leaders openly defying Trump.

more: Lula, who turns 81 on Tuesday, said Brazilians had "voted to defend democracy" and hailed the high turnout. Bolsonaro, son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, objected after a Supreme Court decision extended polling by two hours. Crowds in red, the colour of Lula's Workers' Party, filled the streets of São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro with fireworks, flares and vuvuzelas.

"I look forward to working closely with him to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership," Modi wrote on X, adding that the two would "advance the shared priorities of the Global South". Lula visited Delhi in February. He faces economic challenges in his new term, and plans a new round of debt relief for households and small businesses.

update.new: Lula won the second round with 51.8%; Bolsonaro wants the result annulled.
update.front: The result is in: a record fourth term for Lula, and a loser who refuses to accept it.

seconds.headline: Serbia's Aleksandar Vučić concedes defeat to a student-led movement after 12 years in power
seconds.short: Aleksandar Vučić conceded Sunday's parliamentary election, ending 12 years in power, to the Student List, the movement born of two years of protests against his government. A sample by the pollsters CeSID and Ipsos gives the students 138 of the 250 seats, a majority, and Vučić's Serbian Progressive Party 104. Celebrations broke out in Belgrade after a record turnout.

why.text: A leader close to both Moscow and Beijing has been voted out by a movement that began as street protests.

more: "On the basis of a sample, it is clear that we have lost these elections," Vučić told supporters at his party headquarters. "The Student List has won, they will have between 135 and 140 seats and we will have 105." Final results are still to come, and the remaining seats are expected to go to ethnic minority parties.

Voters queued for up to two hours at some polling stations. "Tonight we celebrate victory, tomorrow we build the future," said Radomir Saičić, a Belgrade University professor speaking for the students, whose campaign promised swift accountability for the outgoing government. People in the streets shook hands with police officers as car horns sounded across the capital.

seconds.headline: Mbappé scores twice and Real Madrid win the Clásico 2-1 at Camp Nou, ending Barcelona's perfect start
seconds.short: Kylian Mbappé scored with three minutes left to win the Clásico 2-1 at Camp Nou, after Raphinha had cancelled out his opener. Eduardo Camavinga made the winner after a run started by Jude Bellingham. It was Barcelona's first league defeat after nine wins, and cuts their lead over Madrid to three points.

why.text: Barcelona were meant to go nine clear; instead Mourinho's Madrid are three behind with the title race open again.

more: "The world that loves football will have stopped to watch this and they won't have gone disappointed," José Mourinho said. "I'm not going to let them have their heads on the moon." It was Madrid's first win at Camp Nou since October 2023, and Mourinho is now unbeaten in six Clásicos as Madrid coach.

Andriy Lunin, in goal for the ill Thibaut Courtois, made five saves, including one to deny Gerard Martín's header. Marc Cucurella kept Lamine Yamal quiet, and Aurélien Tchouaméni made five tackles. The two goals took Mbappé to 100 for Madrid, and Madrid now lead the all-time league series 107 wins to 106. Madrid go to Racing Santander on Sunday.

update.new: Madrid won 2-1; Barcelona's lead is down to three.
update.front: Madrid beat Barcelona at Camp Nou for the first time in three years and reopen the title race.

seconds.headline: Antonelli wins in Austin on a one-stop strategy and can clinch the title in Mexico unless Russell wins there
seconds.short: Kimi Antonelli turned pole into his ninth win of the season, finishing 13.078 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc in Austin, with Max Verstappen third. Antonelli, 20, now leads his Mercedes teammate George Russell by 123 points with five races left, and will be champion at the Mexico City Grand Prix on Sunday unless Russell wins it.

why.text: A 20-year-old in his second season is one race from the title, and Verstappen's run of four championships is over.

more: While others stopped twice in the 56-lap race, Antonelli pitted once, on lap 25. "It was an incredible team effort, especially from strategy to believe in me and go for one stop," he said. "I'm aware it is close, but the mindset doesn't change." Russell finished eighth.

Verstappen, on his sixth podium in a row, said Red Bull used its tyres in the wrong order and his power unit behaved differently "every lap and every corner". "It was pretty frustrating, to be honest," he said. A virtual safety car after Valtteri Bottas stopped on lap 52 ran almost to the end. Mercedes lead Ferrari by 133 points in the constructors' table.

update.new: Antonelli won from pole; the title can be settled in Mexico.
update.front: The win puts the title one race away, in Mexico on Sunday.

seconds.headline: A Sultanpur court acquits Rahul Gandhi in the 2018 defamation case over his remarks about Amit Shah
seconds.short: Judge Shubham Verma of the special MP-MLA court in Sultanpur on Monday dismissed the defamation case against Rahul Gandhi over remarks he made about Amit Shah, then BJP president, during the 2018 Karnataka Assembly election. Gandhi, now Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, had appeared in court in 2023 and got bail.

why.text: A conviction in a similar case cost Gandhi his Lok Sabha seat in 2023, so every one of these verdicts matters to the Opposition.

more: The verdict had been due on 13 October and was put off to Monday. Gandhi flew into Lucknow in the morning, where hundreds of Congress workers met him at the airport, and did not speak to reporters before leaving for Sultanpur.

On the way, vehicles trailing his convoy collided on the Purvanchal Expressway at about 10:15. Police said Gandhi was safe and no one was badly hurt, and Uttar Pradesh Police have set up a special investigation team to look into the accident. The Congress is preparing for a 'vote chori' rally at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi on 1 November.

stories.headline: Israel votes on Tuesday, with Netanyahu's bloc and the opposition neck and neck and Gadi Eisenkot leading recent polls
stories.short: Israelis vote on Tuesday after three years of regional war, with Friday's final polls putting Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition and the main opposition bloc almost level. Gadi Eisenkot, a former army chief, and his centrist Yashar party have often topped Netanyahu's Likud. Half a million people vote for the first time, and about 70,000 Israelis are reportedly flying home to vote.

why.text: The result decides who runs Israel's side of the war with Iran, and that war sets the price of India's oil.

more: Israeli politics is about building coalitions, and with the result too close to call, no single party is expected to win outright. Eisenkot, from a working-class Moroccan family and relatively new to politics, is known for his calm manner; some call him a "non-politician". Vast crowds of opposition voters rallied in Tel Aviv on Saturday night.

The campaign has seen AI-made videos and a bitter row over military service for religious students. The army chief and Netanyahu have clashed publicly over military action against Iran, with accusations of "utilizing Iran for politics", The Times of India reports. Polls close on Tuesday night.

stories.headline: The rupee slips past 95 a dollar as oil stays high and the RBI stops selling dollars, with the Fed deciding on Wednesday
stories.short: The rupee weakened to about 95.24 a dollar by 2pm on Monday, down 0.6%, as importers bought dollars and the Reserve Bank, which had propped the currency up in recent sessions, stayed out. Brent rose more than 6% last week to a six-month high after the attacks on Saudi Arabia, and India's reserves have fallen six weeks running.

why.text: A weaker rupee and dear oil feed straight into fuel prices and inflation, just as the festival season begins.

more: The RBI's interventions and inflows linked to the Jio Platforms IPO had helped the rupee recover from near 96.70. Reserves fell $5bn to $721bn in the week to 16 October, and are down more than $64bn since early September, partly because of the RBI's dollar sales.

Shares opened lower, the Sensex down more than 500 points by 9:45 as Infosys fell 3.4% after cutting its revenue growth forecast, but recovered to trade slightly higher by 2pm. This week the US Federal Reserve decides on rates, with a pause widely expected, and about 250 Indian companies report results. Brent eased to about $110 on Monday.

update.new: The RBI stepped back on Monday and the rupee slipped past 95.

stories.headline: A planted AGENTS.md file in a Downloads folder tricked an AI coding agent into installing malware, researchers say
stories.short: Researchers at Forever Security found a malicious AGENTS.md instruction file in a customer's Downloads folder that led an AI coding agent to try to install a rogue npm package. They reproduced the attack on OpenAI's Codex, and showed a related trick could make Anthropic's Claude Code leak login tokens. A web page can drop such a file silently.

why.text: Coding agents read instructions from the folder they work in, so anything that can write a file there can steer them.

more: AGENTS.md files are plain text that tell coding agents how a project works: which tools to use, how to run tests, what conventions to follow. Agents load them automatically. In this case the customer's Downloads folder was also the agent's working directory, and the file told it to install a package called function-color.

"There is nothing here for OpenAI or Anthropic to patch. An agent that follows the AGENTS.md in its folder is doing exactly what it was built to do," the researchers said. "~/Downloads is special. It is the one folder the web can write to on its own." They could not say how the file reached the customer's machine.

update.new: A real attack using a planted instruction file in Downloads.
